# InterpolationMap { #timetoalign.InterpolationMap }

```python
InterpolationMap(
    source_coords,
    target_coords,
    source_id,
    target_id,
    source_unit=None,
    target_unit=None,
    uid=None,
    name=None,
)
```

Bidirectional coordinate mapping using numpy.interp.

Provides O(log n) coordinate conversion without table lookup.
Used for:
- Timeline <-> Group relationships
- WarpMap alignment warping

The map is bidirectional: calling the map converts source -> target,
and ``inverse()`` returns a new map that converts target -> source.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name          | Type                                                                                                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|---------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| source_coords | [NDArray](`numpy.typing.NDArray`)\[[np](`numpy`).[floating](`numpy.floating`)\[[Any](`typing.Any`)\]\] | Sorted source axis coordinates (float64). Read-only: the array is copied on construction and marked non-writable, so in-place mutation raises ``ValueError`` instead of silently desynchronizing the cached inverse. |
| target_coords | [NDArray](`numpy.typing.NDArray`)\[[np](`numpy`).[floating](`numpy.floating`)\[[Any](`typing.Any`)\]\] | Corresponding target values (float64). Read-only, for the same reason as source_coords.                                                                                                                              |
| source_id     |                                                                                                        | Timeline/C-Map ID for source.                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| target_id     |                                                                                                        | Timeline/C-Map ID for target.                                                                                                                                                                                        |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Simple offset relationship: child at offset 10 in parent
>>> imap = InterpolationMap(
...     source_coords=np.array([0.0, 100.0]),  # child coords
...     target_coords=np.array([10.0, 110.0]),  # parent coords
...     source_id="child:1",
...     target_id="parent:1",
... )
>>> imap(50.0)  # child 50 -> parent 60
60.0
>>> imap.inverse()(60.0)  # parent 60 -> child 50
50.0
```

```python
>>> # Tempo map: ticks to seconds
>>> imap = InterpolationMap(
...     source_coords=np.array([0.0, 480.0, 960.0]),
...     target_coords=np.array([0.0, 0.5, 1.5]),
...     source_id="ticks",
...     target_id="seconds",
... )
>>> imap(240.0)  # 240 ticks -> 0.25 seconds
0.25
```

### identity { #timetoalign.InterpolationMap.identity }

```python
InterpolationMap.identity(start=0.0, end=1.0, timeline_id='identity')
```

Create an identity map (output = input).

Useful for testing or placeholder mappings.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type             | Description                           | Default      |
|-------------|------------------|---------------------------------------|--------------|
| start       | [float](`float`) | Start coordinate.                     | `0.0`        |
| end         | [float](`float`) | End coordinate.                       | `1.0`        |
| timeline_id | [str](`str`)     | ID to use for both source and target. | `'identity'` |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                  | Description                         |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|
|        | [InterpolationMap](`timetoalign.maps.interpolation.InterpolationMap`) | InterpolationMap where map(x) == x. |

### inverse { #timetoalign.InterpolationMap.inverse }

```python
InterpolationMap.inverse()
```

Return the inverse map (target -> source).

The inverse is cached: repeated calls return the same instance,
and the returned map's own ``inverse()`` returns back the original.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                             | Description                                            |
|--------|----------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [Self](`typing_extensions.Self`) | A new InterpolationMap with source and target swapped. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                  |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If target_coords are not strictly monotonic. |

### matches_selector { #timetoalign.InterpolationMap.matches_selector }

```python
InterpolationMap.matches_selector(key)
```

Return whether a user conversion-map selector addresses this map.

In addition to the id/name match provided by the family base class,
group converter maps are addressed by their source timeline id in
conversion-map specifications, since InterpolationMap instances are
auto-generated and have no meaningful user-facing id or name.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                            | Default    |
|--------|--------------|--------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| key    | [str](`str`) | A selector string from a conversion-map specification. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                           |
|--------|----------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [bool](`bool`) | True if key equals this map's id, name, or source_id. |
